description: An asm program as a .NET tool: dotnet pack writes the platform-specific tool packages (PackAsTool), dotnet tool install puts this machine's in a tool folder, and its command runs the program directly.

steps.description: Writes Scenario.AsmHello and one Scenario.AsmHello.<rid> per RID into the local feed.
Installs from the local feed (nuget.config maps Scenario.* to it): NuGet picks this machine's RID package.
Runs the command: a .cmd shim on Windows, a link into the tool store elsewhere.
stdout: asm-hello: a .NET tool written in assembly
